description:
The subtitles of a YouTube, Bilibili or Douyin video as text, each line with its start time: to read,
        summarize, translate or quote what is said in it.

        The site's own subtitles come back free (status "done", `source` "site"). A video without them answers
        status "offer" with its length, the free speech-to-text minutes left and the traffic it would take after
        them: tell the user, and only if they agree call again with that `job_id` and `speech_to_text` true.
        Speech-to-text takes a minute or more and cannot be stopped from here; until it is done, call again with
        the `job_id` and `wait_seconds` 20. A long transcript comes in parts: call again with the `job_id` and
        `from_line` = `next_line`. Asking again with the same link returns the same job.

        Docs: https://fetchpan.com/mcp-server

format.description: "lines" (each line with its start time), "text" (the words only) or "srt" (a subtitle file)
format.title: Format

from_line.description: A later part of a long transcript: next_line from the previous answer
from_line.title: From Line

job_id.description: From an earlier get_subtitles answer: to look again, to accept its offer or to read more lines
job_id.title: Job Id

speech_to_text.description: With job_id, only after the user agreed to that answer's offer: turn the video's speech into text (the free minutes first, then traffic)
speech_to_text.title: Speech To Text

url.description: A YouTube, Bilibili or Douyin video link (or the share text the app copied), as the user gave it
url.title: Url

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long (at most 20 s) for the subtitles
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

name: get_subtitles
title: Get a video's subtitles
